mapper.insert: insert into jiedan_audit_log (create_time, actor_id, actor_name, actor_role, action, target_type, target_id, target_name, detail, ip) values (#{time}, #{actorId}, #{actorName}, #{actorRole}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetName}, #{detail}, #{ip})

where.if: and (target_name like concat('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') or detail like concat('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') or actor_name like concat('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
select id as id, create_time as createTime, actor_id as actorId, actor_name as actorName, actor_role as actorRole, action as action, target_type as targetType, target_id as targetId, target_name as targetName, detail as detail, ip as ip from jiedan_audit_log
order by id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
